text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy was defeated in the Arima 
Kinen. She roared fiercely toward the 
heavens in frustration.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
Whether she became a lingering regret for 
Symboli Kris S remains unknown, and her 
retirement wasn't canceled. ...However, 
she could feel the impact she had made.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
The next target is the Tenno Sho (Spring). 
Zenno Rob Roy won't halt her strides— so 
that when she returns, she can welcome her 
as a true champion.
